settings.heading: Product Specifications
settings.content:
Modern C-Shaped Design: Sleek and minimalist, the C-shaped profile allows the table to slide under sofas, beds, or chairs for convenient use as a laptop desk, coffee table, or side accent

Walnut-Finish Top: The tabletop is crafted from high-quality blister density board (MDF) with a rich walnut finish, giving it a smooth, stylish look that complements any interior.

Stable Metal Base: Supported by a thick black steel frame and reinforced oval base for maximum stability, durability, and a touch of contemporary flair.

Space-Saving Side Table For Couches : If you're looking for space-saving furniture for a small room, this compact sofa table is perfect for you. It doesn't require much space but is incredibly useful as a versatile side table, coffee table, or snack holder. Its Space-saving and C shape design easily slides under sofas or beds. Perfect for small apartments, dorms, and compact rooms.

settings.heading: Product features
settings.content:
Smooth & Easy to Clean: The surface is water stain-resistant, friction-resistant, and wipes clean easily—ideal for hassle-free daily use and entertaining.

Compact & Versatile: At 58 cm high with a 38 x 28 cm tabletop, it fits perfectly in small spaces for use as a bedside or sofa table, plant stand, or reading nook companion.

Multipurpose Functionality: Perfect for serving snacks, drinks, reading material, and even as a workspace for laptops or tablets—great for living rooms, bedrooms, balconies, or offices.

settings.heading: Materials and care
settings.content:
Materials: 

Tabletop made from premium blister density board (engineered MDF) finished in walnut; base constructed of robust steel with a powder-coated black finish for long-lasting strength.

Care Instructions:

  • Wipe surface regularly with a soft, damp cloth to remove dust and spills.
  • Do not use harsh chemicals or abrasive cleaners on the tabletop or metal base.
  • Clean up liquid spills promptly to maintain the finish.
  • Avoid placing hot pans or sharp objects directly on the tabletop to prevent marks or scratches.
  • For best results, use coasters or mats under cups and decor.
